events.title: Темари против Саске Учихи
events.result: Sasuke Uchihа wins last quarterfinal vs Temari. Temari wind slashes and wide fan; Sasuke Sharingan anticipates, temporarily wires fan, uses Katon Gokakyu fireball, which Temari disrupts into high curtain by wind. Sasuke closes from edge of curtain, strikes fan shaft then supporting thigh and disarms; holds kunai at throat; Temari explicitly yields. Temari sore ribs from previous Naruto bout but conscious, mobile, alive; Sasuke no established serious wounds.

events.title: Aki confirmed diagnostics
events.result: Med aide reports imaging shows undisplaced fibula fracture and partial/incomplete tibial fissure. Distal foot perfusion remains intact, no clinical signs of critical muscle-compartment pressure at present, serial observation continues. Aki asks Shiki not to lose or seek revenge on her behalf: she will handle Gaara herself once walking again. Aki remains in medical care.

events.title: Shiki versus Gaara first semifinal called
events.result: Genma calls Shiki and Gaara. Gaara walks to arena access and verbally provokes Shiki regarding Aki being weaker than she thought and whether Shiki will stop when hurt. Gaara not yet in combat, Shiki remains on participants stand, has not spoken or moved since latest turn. Battle not begun. Lee concerned and Guy wary of Gaara's autonomous sand.
